note: Fifty requests that need more than one tool, with the sequence that satisfies them. Graded by edit distance against goldSequence rather than set overlap, because order is the thing under test: reading a script after replacing it is the same set and not the same trajectory. `anyOrderPrefix` marks a leading run whose internal order does not matter.
